title: Report Templates and Branding
summary: Defines the ReportContext envelope, closed block catalog, org brand kit, and template chrome used to render host and application PDF exports.
coverage: Typed report context and token registry
Block composition and named PDF regions
Org brand kit versus template chrome

warning.title: IMPORTANT
paragraphs: Template and brand-kit changes affect future generated PDFs only. Existing generated files are not retroactively rewritten.

sections.title: Governance scope
paragraphs: Template governance is managed in `Settings -> Report Templates`. This area controls template identity, linear block order, chrome strings, placeholders, supported scopes, and enabled state. The org brand kit on the same page owns company name, print ink, and logo.
Only users with `manage_report_templates` can create, edit, enable, disable, reset, or delete report templates, and can update the brand kit.

rows: User can select enabled templates in pentest record or app export sheet and call generate. Admin or `manage_report_templates` may also generate from a disabled template.
Can request `include_disabled=true` and see the full template catalog.
Can delete custom templates and reset system templates to canonical.
Read and update org brand kit
Can call `GET`/`PUT /report-brand-kit` and upload a kit logo.

sections.title: Template data contract
paragraphs: Backend validates template payloads before commit. Unknown block types, unknown chart ids, and unknown `{{tokens}}` are rejected. Layout coordinates are stripped and never rendered.

sections.title: Supported block types and rendering behavior
paragraphs: Block order in the builder is the final render order. `render_pentest_report_pdf` consumes a typed `ReportContext` and a template definition. Cover, running header, and footer are named regions; the body is a linear Platypus story. Host-only blocks omit cleanly when the envelope has no host data.

sections.title: Placeholders, tokens, and brand kit
paragraphs: Variable tokens from application, wave, package, host, pentest, metrics, export, and placeholder groups can be embedded in titles, subtitles, chrome, and text block content. The token registry is closed: unknown `{{paths}}` raise at normalize and render.

The org brand kit supplies company name, print ink (default `#067A8A`), and logo. Table headers, section titles, and the cover company name use print ink. Running footer is company name and date; it does not print package, hash, or HMAC.

tip.title: TIP
paragraphs: Upload the brand-kit logo as a PNG. The PDF image fetcher only accepts RAPTOR pentest image URLs of the form `/pentest/images/<filename>.png`.
